items.title: Standardized pre-consultation by a large language model agent vs ophthalmology residents: a randomized clinical trial
items.excerpt: A randomized clinical trial at a tertiary ophthalmology center compared a dual-agent LLM pre-consultation history-taking agent against ophthalmology residents.

items.title: Real-world user interactions with large language models for explaining home electrocardiogram reports
items.excerpt: A real-world analysis of how users of portable home ECG devices query LLMs to interpret their electrocardiogram reports, and where the explanations help or fall short.

items.title: VOICE-AE: automated CTCAE scoring from ambient clinical audio using speech recognition and large language models
items.excerpt: VOICE-AE combines speech recognition, speaker diarization and LLMs to extract and grade treatment-related adverse events (CTCAE) directly from recorded oncology clinic conversations.

items.title: Characterizing Artificial Intelligence Psychosis in a Large Medical Setting
items.excerpt: A cohort study in a large health system estimates the prevalence of "AI psychosis," characterizes affected patients and defines the role conversational AI played in documented psychotic episodes.

items.title: A Precedent for Regulating Clinical AI Models
items.excerpt: A JAMA Forum piece on regulating clinical AI models already in use, proposing an improved version of the laboratory-developed-test pathway to support AI innovation.

items.title: Chatbot Intervention and Cancer Risk Knowledge in Adolescents and Young Adults With Cancer Predisposition
items.excerpt: A multicenter randomized clinical trial tested a chatbot cancer-risk communication tool for adolescents and young adults with hereditary cancer predisposition.

items.title: HHS announces new efforts to speed up, expand clinical trials with AI
items.excerpt: HHS and ARPA-H unveiled new programs to use AI to speed up and expand clinical trials, framed as a bid to compete with China on clinical research.

items.title: Opinion: I’m a doctor. Here’s what I want the public to know about AI tools and health care costs
items.excerpt: A physician responds to BCBS research on AI documentation tools raising bills: "We can document honestly and still wind up inflating hospital bills."

items.title: FDA to prioritize guidance on AI, surgical robots next year
items.excerpt: The FDA device center plans to finalize guidance for AI-enabled devices, draft generative-AI advice and address surgical robots in its fiscal 2027 guidance agenda.

items.title: Data privacy concerns could hold patients back from using AI
items.excerpt: A new survey finds patients increasingly worried about their health data as AI becomes embedded in care, which could limit their willingness to use AI tools.

items.title: Insurers say AI could add billions in health costs. Billing companies disagree
items.excerpt: Insurer studies say provider-side AI documentation and coding tools raise health costs; the vendors argue the problem is the billing system, not the AI.

items.title: Physicians fire back against HHS secretary’s claim AI is ‘better informed’ than human docs
items.excerpt: Physician groups pushed back after HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said AI is "better informed" than doctors and could "free us from medical tyranny."

items.title: Radiology AI authorizations rise 42% as regulatory landscape evolves
items.excerpt: An analysis of the FDA AI-enabled device database shows radiology AI authorizations up 42% and details how the regulatory standing of these tools has shifted.

items.title: AI Can Flag Cognitive Decline Earlier — Health Systems Still Own What Happens Next
items.excerpt: AI flags of early cognitive decline in the EHR create a clinical duty; health systems must decide in advance how a risk signal becomes an accountable care pathway.

items.title: Weekly Rundown: Nextech taps Assort Health, EliseAI for agentic AI; Elsevier rolls out clinical AI tool for nurses
items.excerpt: Week of Oct. 5-9: Nextech integrates agentic AI patient-access tools into its specialty EHR (incl. an ophthalmology-specific agent), Elsevier launches a clinical AI tool for nurses, and HHS awards $15M to AI projects.

items.title: 심평원 AI 심사 강화에…‘사전점검 솔루션’ 주목
items.excerpt: 심평원이 9월부터 무릎관절 분야 AI 의료영상 판독 결과를 실제 진료비 심사에 반영하기 시작하면서, 의료기관 쪽 사전점검 솔루션 고도화 경쟁이 붙고 있다.

items.title: AI 시대 병원은 어디로…세계 병원 리더들, 서울서 답 찾는다
items.excerpt: 대한병원협회와 국제병원연맹이 10월 19~22일 서울에서 제49차 세계병원대회를 열고 ‘글로벌 AI 헬스케어 서울선언’을 채택할 예정이다.

items.title: AI 신약개발 ‘K-멜로디’ 사업, 종료 후 운영계획 부실 지적
items.excerpt: 총 348억원이 투입되는 연합학습 기반 AI 신약개발 지원사업 K-멜로디가 사업 종료 이후 운영계획이 부실하다는 지적을 받았다.

items.title: 초음파 검사의 ‘검사자 의존성’ 한계 넘는다…배럴아이, AI·정량화·자율 로봇 융합
items.excerpt: 배럴아이가 AI 판독, 정량화, 자율 로봇 스캐닝을 결합해 검사자 숙련도에 좌우되던 초음파 검사의 한계를 줄이겠다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 분당서울대병원 황성일 교수팀, 바이브코딩으로 4시간 만에 만든 판독 도구 공개
items.excerpt: 코딩 경험 없는 영상의학과 의사가 생성형 AI와 약 4시간 대화해 PI-RADS 2.1 기반 전립선 MRI 구조화 판독 도구를 만들었다는 사례가 KJR에 보고됐다.

items.title: 온코소프트, ASTRO 2026에서 AI 기반 방사선치료의 다음 단계 제시
items.excerpt: 온코소프트가 ASTRO 2026에서 FDA 인허가 ‘온코스튜디오’ 차세대 기능과 식약처 허가 중입자치료 TPS ‘온코플랜’ 등 에이전틱 AI 방사선치료 솔루션을 선보였다.

items.title: 박유경 교수 "서울아산병원 소아 RRS에 들어온 AI…고위험 환아 조기 선별에 도움"
items.excerpt: 서울아산병원 소아 신속대응시스템(RRS)에 도입된 뷰노 AI가 데이터 누락과 알람 피로를 보완하며 고위험 환아를 조기에 선별하는 데 도움이 된다는 임상 경험이 소개됐다.

items.title: 에이아이트릭스, 미측정 정보로 환자 악화 예측…연구논문 게재
items.excerpt: 에이아이트릭스의 일반병동 환자 악화 예측 AI 모델 MADE가 EHR의 관측값과 미측정 패턴을 함께 활용하는 연구로 JAMIA에 게재됐다.
